claims.text: Non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations in transcriptions that include mispronunciations, poor intelligibility, and other disfluencies.
Annotations for non-standardized orthographic transcriptions are useful for studying historical language changes and building spelling normalization systems.
The lack of standardized orthography in Mapudungun contributes to the identification of non-standard pronunciations during transcription.
